runs.command: uv run --no-project --python E:/software/miniforge/python.exe --with-requirements minimal-requirements.txt --with pytest --with pytest-timeout -- python -m pytest tests/test_terminal_api.py -o addopts= -q -p no:cacheprovider
runs.notes: uv installed 42 packages into an ephemeral env (no lock changes)

deterministic_gates.body_identity_forgery_zero_effect: extra fields context/created_by/trusted_local/terminal_id/token/shell_argv -> 422 unknown-field; legit create kwargs == {rows,cols,cwd,workspace_id,session_id,context}; context is web-local/trusted_local
deterministic_gates.cancel_keeps_slot_until_thread_completes: after cancel inflight stays 4; -> 0 only after thread end
deterministic_gates.startup_not_fake_ready: starting -> 503 not-ready; reconcile failure -> 503 terminal-unavailable with service ref kept
deterministic_gates.shutdown_unconfirmed_keeps_references: budget 0.2s vs 1.0s shutdown -> unconfirmed true, retained_service true, late result consumed
deterministic_gates.snapshot_degrade_no_upgrade: reasons==[] not upgraded; reset_unconfirmed 'true' -> null; auto_reset_applied false
deterministic_gates.secret_non_leak: views have no pipe/token/pan-terminal-; exception text not echoed (500 internal-error)
deterministic_gates.disabled_no_construction: non-Windows / non-loopback binding -> 503 terminal-disabled and service == None
deterministic_gates.import_no_side_effects: fresh interpreter: no threads, no PAN_TERMINALS_DIR created

real_asgi_chain.transport: httpx ASGITransport (no listening socket, no 8768, no full Pan lifespan)

observed.create: 200 ok, status=running, pid present, no pipe/secret in body
observed.read: 200 ok, base64 output non-empty (default shell banner)
observed.snapshot: 200 ok, 128KiB cap respected, F5 bool-or-null, continuation_hint in allowed set
observed.close: 200 ok status=exited after proof; secret file deleted
observed.residue: same-handle identity probe: runner not alive; no lingering pan-terminal/sidecar processes

defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: slots leaked on every successful call (try/else + return skips else) -> subsequent requests 429 busy; four-slot test showed inflight==3 after completion
defect_found_and_fixed.observed_before_fix: 11 failed, 16 passed (first run of the file)
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: recycle slot explicitly after a successful await; cancel path delegates to task done-callback

divergences: REST validates rows/cols 1..1000 (per brief) while TerminalService.create guards rows<=500; service 'invalid-size' is mapped to 422 invalid-size (input class), not 502
snapshot-too-large status code unspecified in brief; chosen 502
readiness code split into not-ready / terminal-unavailable / terminal-disabled to avoid colliding with create's 502 startup-failed
not_tested: full Pan lifespan, provider/account/network services, port 8768
remote (non-loopback) exposure; PAN_TERMINAL_ALLOW_REMOTE is not authentication
cross-host/cross-user, POSIX, long-run backpressure, cross-sidecar restart recovery
cross-process concurrent create on a shared PAN_TERMINALS_DIR
